text:
rachel: hey team — opened a small PR that touches tracehook sampling and a dashboard metric rename. can someone give a quick safety check? link: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/4821 :hand:

alex: looking now, thanks for the ping. is this intended to be a canary-only change or full rollout?

rachel: canary-only for now. goal is to avoid a flood of low-value traces. i added a feature flag and a rollout policy in the config.

mike: quick skim — config looks fine but i think the metric rename will break any dashboards that reference the old name. do we have a migration?

rachel: good point. i added a thin migration script in the PR that transforms existing dashboard JSON via the console api. snippet:
```bash
# run once during canary deploy
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://console.internal/api/v1/dashboards/migrate
  -d '{"from":"obs.trace.count_v1","to":"obs.trace.count_v2"}'
```

jane: can you add a short note to the release checklist so on-call knows to run that if canary goes green?

rachel: added checklist item in the PR description.

alex: code nit: in tracehook sampler, prefer `>=` vs `>` for the sample-rate check. tiny but will avoid off-by-one.

rachel: updated. thanks.

infra-bot: CI: build passed (linux), unit tests passed, infra-lint failed on `conftest.py` but is pre-merge optional.

mike: who can approve for canary today? i can if no objections.

sre-rotating: canary okay from SRE side as long as we keep sampling rate at 0.01 default and have fallback to full-trace on error. also add a quick dashboard panel for trace-rate post rollout so we can watch.

rachel: fallback added, dashboard panel added to PR. tagging @alex @mike for approvals.

alex: approving now. :thumbsup:

mike: approved, will schedule canary slot at 16:30 UTC.

rachel: perfect — i'll cut the canary and run the migration after smoke pass. thanks everyone!

alex: ping if anything flaps, otherwise good to go.

sre-rotating: noted, i'll watch for increased span counts during the window.
